morphology.formula: ∅ + firestorm → firestorm；英语内部构词：fire + storm → firestorm
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包视为整体词项；英语中为复合词，主重音在首部。IPA采用英式读音；输入包未提供音节划分及Jawi，保留null。

word_family.gloss: 多场烈火风暴；多次激烈争议

senses.zh_definition: 烈火风暴：强烈燃烧产生上升气流，并吸入周围空气形成强风、进一步助长火势的大规模火灾。
senses.en_definition: An exceptionally intense fire whose rising heat draws in strong winds that further feed the flames.
senses.ms_definition: Kebakaran amat dahsyat yang menghasilkan aliran udara menaik lalu menarik masuk angin kuat yang menyemarakkan api.
senses.nuances: 英语名词。此处马来文为释义性转述，并非DBP官方原文；不能把所有大型火灾都称为firestorm。headword.status按指定格式保留official，仅表示本条记录的指定状态，不证明该英语词已获认可为标准马来词。词频排名来自输入包。[词义参考：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/firestorm)。

collocations.zh: 森林火灾引发的烈火风暴
collocations.en: a firestorm caused by a forest fire

senses.zh_definition: 突然爆发且声势强烈的争议、批评或愤怒浪潮。
senses.en_definition: A sudden, intense outbreak of controversy, criticism, or anger.
senses.ms_definition: Gelombang kontroversi, kritikan atau kemarahan yang tercetus secara mendadak dan hebat.
senses.nuances: 英语比喻义，常见于媒体报道；马来语正式行文可依语境使用gelombang kritikan、kontroversi hebat或kemarahan meluas。所列马来文搭配属于英马语码混用示例，不是标准马来语固定搭配。[词义参考：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/firestorm)。

collocations.zh: 在社交媒体掀起激烈争议
collocations.en: to trigger a firestorm on social media

collocations.ms: berdepan dengan firestorm selepas kenyataan itu
collocations.zh: 在发表该言论后面对猛烈批评
collocations.en: to face a firestorm after that statement

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 媒体用语说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan berbahasa Inggeris itu menyifatkan reaksi orang ramai sebagai “firestorm”, iaitu gelombang kritikan hebat terhadap keputusan syarikat tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该英文报道以“firestorm”形容公众反应，即针对该公司决定的猛烈批评浪潮。
dual_scenarios.en: The English-language report described the public reaction as a “firestorm”, meaning a wave of intense criticism of the company's decision.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论网络争议
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Baru satu hantaran je, dah jadi firestorm kat media sosial.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Hanya satu hantaran sudah mencetuskan gelombang kritikan hebat di media sosial.
dual_scenarios.zh: 才发了一条帖子，就在社交媒体炸开锅了。
dual_scenarios.en: Just one post, and it's already sparked a firestorm on social media.
spoken_features: firestorm是嵌入马来语句子的英语名词。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok hantaran tu? Dah jadi firestorm kat media sosial.
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah melihat hantaran itu? Hantaran itu sudah mencetuskan gelombang kritikan hebat di media sosial.
messages.zh: 你看那条帖子了吗？网上已经吵翻了。
messages.en: Have you seen that post? It's already caused a firestorm on social media.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Aku nak baca penjelasan dia dulu, jangan terus kongsi je.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya mahu membaca penjelasannya dahulu; jangan terus berkongsi hantaran itu.
messages.zh: 看了。我想先看看他的解释，别直接就转发。
messages.en: Yeah. I want to read his explanation first. Don't just share it straight away.

etymology.historical_story: English combines fire and storm to name a blaze powerful enough to generate fierce inward winds. The physical image also supports a figurative meaning: criticism arrives with overwhelming force, like flames driven by turbulent air. In Malay contexts, the English expression can appear in quotations or code-switching; its imagery remains English rather than a native Malay derivation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语fire（火）与storm（风暴）连起来：现实中是烈火风暴，舆论中就是批评如风暴般扑来。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉英语的朋友之间可使用；面向广泛公众或正式马来文读者时，按具体意思改用清楚的马来语表达。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 比喻义语气强烈，适合确有大规模激烈反应的情境。讨论真实火灾及受灾者时，应明确区分灾害术语与舆论比喻。
